free_tier.correction: false for the hosted libretranslate.com API; self-hosting is free, but the managed service has no free trial or free low-volume API key

free_tier_limits.correction: No hosted free tier; therefore no free-tier limits apply

rate_limits.correction: Published burst limits are up to 80 translations per minute for Pro and 200 translations per minute for Business; higher custom limits are available by contacting support

cors.correction: yes; the official implementation adds Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and permits GET and POST

notes: The hosted service requires a paid API key. Self-hosting remains free, and official mirrors include some keyless third-party instances, but neither constitutes a free tier on libretranslate.com. The portal publishes current plan prices and burst limits, while the official source code confirms permissive CORS support.
